steps.prompt: Before the check: write one restated thesis and one final thought about any topic you like.

cards.title: Conclusions & full essays: quick review
cards.body: Conclusion: restate the thesis in new words → sum up → final thought (narratives: a reflection). Informative: explain three parts. Narrative: events in order, then reflect. Argumentative: two reasons with evidence, the other side and your answer.

cards.title: Edit with the checklist
cards.body: Write your draft, then edit with the essay checklist until every item is done. The automatic items tick themselves; tick the rest yourself after checking.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First, a 10-question quiz: you need 8 right (80%) to pass. If you don’t pass, you’ll see which skills to review, and you’ll get new questions next time. Then you’ll write and edit a full argumentative essay. Quill gives it a score.

prompts: Which part of an essay is now easiest for you? Which is still hard?
Which checklist item will you remember next time?
